entities.name: Query AGPAT enzyme
observations: 279-aa protein with an N-terminal hydrophobic membrane-targeting region and a predicted PF01553 acyltransferase domain at residues 78–206.
Has 80.8% sequence identity and 97.1% query coverage to reviewed human AGPAT2 (UniProt O15120).
Best-supported function is 1-acyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity, EC 2.3.1.51.

entities.name: AGPAT2
observations: Reviewed human 1-acyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase beta; homologous to the query at 80.8% identity.
Localized to the endoplasmic-reticulum membrane and catalyzes phosphatidic-acid formation from lysophosphatidic acid and acyl-CoA.

entities.name: LPA acylation to phosphatidic acid
observations: This is Rhea RHEA:19709 and corresponds to EC 2.3.1.51.

entities.name: Query enzyme sequence features
observations: Length 279 aa; estimated molecular mass 31.2 kDa; predicted pI 9.33.
The sequence contains a strongly hydrophobic N-terminal segment consistent with membrane association or insertion.
